subject: Re: Kickoff - resourcing and the B-81 funding
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing:
- Umar Costa 50%, predictor and the margin/total-variation feature work.
- Ondrej Bergstrom 40%, model zoo training harness.
- Hyun Traore 20%, evaluation and the cost model.

The expensive part is our own zoo. Training ~200 internal configs to convergence is roughly 41,000 GPU-hours. That does not fit in best-effort titan capacity without pushing everyone else out, so it needs real money.

Idris has verbally earmarked the full $120k available on Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-81 for demogen - that is the whole line, and it covers the model-zoo training in May and June. I have not seen it in writing yet but he was unambiguous on the call.

If that funding moves, the Jun 5 milestone moves with it and we fall back to a 60-config zoo, which weakens the predictor evaluation considerably.

Daniela
